nodes.name: Sklearn Linear Model Coordinate Descent CV Subclass API Shell Helper Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic subclass API-shell helpers from sklearn.linear_model._coordinate_descent for LassoCV, ElasticNetCV, MultiTaskLassoCV, and MultiTaskElasticNetCV around path selection, estimator selection, multitask tags, and super().fit delegation.

nodes.name: cd_cv_subclass_path_name
nodes.description: Return the path helper selected by a coordinate-descent CV subclass.

nodes.name: cd_cv_subclass_estimator_name
nodes.description: Return the concrete estimator selected by a CV subclass _get_estimator method.

nodes.name: cd_cv_subclass_is_multitask
nodes.description: Return the boolean _is_multitask value for a CV subclass.

nodes.name: cd_cv_subclass_target_single_output_tag
nodes.description: Return the target_tags.single_output override used by multitask CV subclasses.

nodes.name: cd_cv_subclass_fit_forwards_sample_weight
nodes.description: Return whether subclass fit forwards sample_weight into LinearModelCV.fit.

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: true only for mono-output CV subclasses

nodes.name: cd_cv_subclass_super_fit_args
nodes.description: Return positional args for subclass super().fit(X, y, ...).

inputs.name: X
inputs.type_desc: training data passed to subclass fit

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: two-tuple preserving X and y identity

nodes.name: cd_cv_subclass_super_fit_kwargs
nodes.description: Return keyword args for subclass super().fit(...), optionally including sample_weight.
nodes.type_signature: (params: dict[object, object], sample_weight: object, forwards_sample_weight: bool) -> dict[object, object]

inputs.name: params
inputs.type_desc: metadata routing params passed to subclass fit

inputs.name: sample_weight
inputs.type_desc: sample_weight payload available to mono-output CV subclasses
